pages.title: Lights out · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight at night in a tall building in Miami. Suddenly, all the lights go out. The hall is completely black. Nate opens his door and holds his phone as a light. His neighbor Rosa stands in the dark with a small flashlight. They look at each other and laugh nervously.
“Rosa! The lights went out. Is it only our apartment?” says Rosa. “No, the whole building is dark.” says Rosa. “Do you have a flashlight?” says Rosa.

pages.title: Lights out · 3/3
paragraphs: “Good idea. Please keep the fridge closed.” says Rosa. “Right. The food stays cold for a few hours.” says Rosa. Nate brings three candles and a box of matches. They sit in the hall and talk for an hour. Other neighbors come out and share snacks. At ten, the lights come back with a loud click. Everyone cheers and says goodnight. A dark night can bring a building together.
